pickups.note: Issue #64: rides on the pit hauler, the old cargo droid that roams the pit (droids/droids.json, pit_hauler); its position here is only where it starts. taken_flag: set when someone takes it (Oda's rumor r_pit_hauler stops).
Issue #148: rides on the old cargo droid in the crashed starcruiser's deep hold (droids/droids.json, wreck.hauler); its position here is only where it starts.
A smuggler's drop outside the front gate: three cases of unmarked cells. Worth 90 cr to the fence, if you can get them past the checkpoint.

note: Items lying in the town. Positions are a town marker plus an offset, so no coordinates live in code. The jetpack sits at the top of one of the pit's ramps, on street level, where the walk out of the pit passes it (inside the pit, E launches the ship). A pickup taken once stays taken (saved).

drops.note: Hiding places for Oda's smuggling run (board/bar_board.json, j_smuggle_run). Each run picks one area (never the same one twice in a row) and one spot in it. Oda only names the area, so the player has to search it. A spot is an offset from the area's marker. ground: snap the drop to the desert terrain. Drops have no glow ring, so out in the sand they are hard to spot. marked (issue #64): a drop in the streets or on a roof gets a beam of light over it, so it can be found in town.

areas.hint: out in the sand past the front gate
in the dunes outside the back gate
tucked in one of the alleys between the houses
up on one of the low house roofs. Bring something that flies
